style_note: Bai insight/loi khuyen truc tiep kieu 'hay/dung', KHONG phai van xuoi van hoc an du. Xem 3 vi du mau da duyet: tuong phan nhan thuc (nguoi moi vs bac thay) + ket bai bang cap reframe 'dung hoi X - hay hoi Y'. Reframe question o cuoi CHINH LA CTA - khong them CTA rieng kieu like/tag.
content_dna: Giong van nhat quan qua cac bai: truc tiep, am ap, khong hoa my. Luon mo dau bang cau tuong phan sac, khong throat-clearing. Luon ket bang cap reframe cau hoi. Su nhat quan nay giup thuat toan Facebook 'gan nhan' dung doc gia qua thoi gian.
avoid: generic filler like 'moi thu deu co ly do cua no'
empty motivation with no real contrast behind it
long literary description that delays the point
engagement bait: 'like neu dong y', 'tag 3 nguoi ban', 'tha tim neu thay dung'
emoji_policy: 0-2 emoji toi da, chi o dau dong hanh dong neu can, khong bat buoc, mac dinh khong dung
